Criterion: Verify that wiring design provides primary and secondary support for the wiring throughout the installation. Standard: Wiring support complies with good design practice, as defined in SAE AS50881 for aircraft and NFPA 70 for ground stations. Other specification(s) may apply for shipboard and ground mobile applications. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis and inspection. Analysis and inspection of design, including drawings, documents, and assembled product verify proper support of wiring. References: For guidance/principles regarding the provision of proper support for wiring: JSSG-2001: 4.3.10.1.1 JSSG-2009: 3.2.6; 3.2.7.2; H.6.3.1; H.6.3.2. SAE AS50881 NFPA 70

Standard: The wiring design provides primary and secondary support for the new or impacted existing wiring throughout the installation IAW SAE AS50881, Primary Support paragraphs and Secondary Support paragraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) A wiring design documentation (e.g., schematics, drawings, and models) review verifies primary and secondary supports for the wiring are provided throughout the installation.
(2) A physical installation examination through the means of a first article inspection, verification, or quality assurance review verifies primary and secondary supports for the wiring throughout the installation IAW SAE AS50881, Primary Support paragraphs and Secondary Support paragraphs.
